programs.title: Mr. Bean
programs.desc: Mr Bean is painting a picture of Teddy when he accidently squirts some green paint onto his brown wallpaper.  Oh no! Bean needs to redecorate his room fast but ends up painting all the walls a garish lime green instead of brown. He’s so terrified of Mrs Wicket finding out that when he goes to bed he has some very weird nightmares – with a rather sickly ending.
